description: Creates 1 to 10 servers (default limit 3 per call) and waits up to about two minutes for ACTIVE, then returns ids, IPv4 and the SSH command. Spends money: billed per hour from the balance until the server is destroyed. Refused with the price if the total hourly price is above max_hourly_usd (default $1); more than 3 servers also need an explicit max_hourly_usd. Without ssh_public_key a random root password is generated and returned once, and it stays in the chat history. app installs a one-click app (Docker, WireGuard, WordPress and others) on Ubuntu 24.04 instead of a plain OS.

app.description: One-click app id, e.g. "docker" or "wireguard". Replaces os; the app installs on first boot.

label.description: Server name: Latin letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore. With count > 1 it gets -1, -2, ...

max_hourly_usd.description: Upper bound for the total hourly price of this call, default 1.

os.description: OS id or name, default "ubuntu-24.04". Ignored for GPU plans.

plan.description: Plan id, e.g. "vc2-1c-1gb", or a plan name like "Micro".

provider.description: Cloud; default is the cheapest that deploys this plan in this city.

region.description: City id or name, e.g. "fra" or "Frankfurt".

ssh_public_key.description: One public key line (ssh-ed25519 ..., ssh-rsa ...), installed for root.
